notes.title: Farm Manager Word - 1.0 Release today!
notes.content:

[list]
[*] 3 new Campaigns
[*] 8 new scenarios
[*] 3 multiplayer scenarios
[*] Regions of the world (Europe, Central America, Asia)
->  Various climate, terrain, vegetation
->  Changed some buildings look based on region
[*] Fields and work in the fields
-> More metrics for fields: soil class, pH, nitrogen levels.
-> Crop rotation
-> Connecting/disconnecting fields
-> Possibility of automatic mechanical/manual operation or independent
-> selection of vehicles and workers
-> Ability to add workers to ongoing field work

->  80 crop species (32 new)
->  Plants compedium
[*] Animals
->  Cyclic ordering/selling of animals

->  20 species of animals (3 new +2)

[*] Vehicles
-> 35 refreshed vehicles and machines (new orchard tractor)
->  Fuel
->  Manufacturing plants
->  New processing plants including biorefinery
->  Many new product types
->  Ability to create more production lines
[*] Multiplayer
->  Exchange of products and machines
->  Collaborative completion of scenario objectives
->  Shared free game
[*] Employees
->  Changed skills system
->  New look
->  Choosing if employee can be a driver
[*] Mods support
[*] Planning mode for creating farm layout
[*] Trading Contracts
[*] More leasing options
[*] Help Center
[*] Logistic system
[*] Resource orders in warehouses
[*] New trainings
[*] Refreshed and expanded interface
[*] Improved graphics and optimization
[/list]

notes.title: 1.1.529 - Autumn Update
notes.content:
Dear Players, 
To celebrate the harvest season and Halloween, we have an autumn update for you today. We’ve addressed some older issues and added new content to help you get your farms into the autumn spirit!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/6c52b4396923da7c943514297053902aa4794452.png[/img]

You’ll find the full changelog below. Happy farming and Happy Halloween!

[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*]New animated windmill decoration
[*]New animated scarecrow decoration
[*]New red tree variants added
[*]Multiple decorative pumpkins added, regular pumpkins and Halloween-carved ones
[*]New haystack decoration
[*]Main house now has a black farm cat patrolling the grounds, looking for mice
[*]Some classic tunes from Farm Manager 2018 have been added to the music
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Graphic settings defaults to highest instead of low (only impacts new players)
[*]Camera no longer rotates when you shift focus from different employee housings
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed some strings not showing up in the correct language
[*]Fixed an issue where farm fields prompts that there’s no water trailer available even though the field relies on irrigation
[/list]

notes.title: Farm Manager 2021 - Patch 1.1.513
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Below you will find the changelog:

[h1]New features[/h1]

[b]Buying multiple machines
[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/8931201d0ba848da502397f0ab5195fb4b026113.png[/img]
To buy more than one machine, you must visit the Machine Market tab, click on the Buy Multiple checkbox and fill the empty parking spaces with the selected machine. Please note that you cannot buy multiple machines in used condition.

[b]New warning - Machine is busy[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/a9efe9d9c54da36cb80ab8df812ed2b89f2ef34f.png[/img]
The new warning helps you to see if you have not bought the machine you need, or if the machine is simply busy with another job. The new warning is displayed as a 3d icon above the field and does not appear on the left warning field. To see the details of a warning, you need to expand the tab of a field that displays the 3d warning.

- Added camera control by clicking and dragging. From now on you can use the right mouse button to navigate your farm
- Added shortcuts to managers. Clicking on the current account balance opens the Economy Manager and clicking on the staff counter opens the Staff Manager


Changes
- Employees always choose the machine that is closest to them
- Several changes to the readability of UI, including larger font sizes

Bug fixes
- Fixed a bug that allowed the Farm owner's house to be upgraded while a machine parked in the farm owner's house was performing field work
- Fixed a bug that caused the staff to walk through the walls of the garages
- Fixed a bug that caused a loan to disappear without being paid off

notes.title: Natural Instincts releases in Early Access!
notes.content:
Hello Farmers! 
We know that you are masters of managing farm animals and taking care of ostriches, cows, and even boars. Will you manage to put these skills to use in the wilderness?[b] European forest and its inhabitants await you[/b] in the new upcoming strategy game called[b] Natural Instincts which releases this Thursday, July 22, in Early Access! 
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/2edc6b4072c6ffc1cf4a8c89314a415710e2abac.png[/img]

Get to know [b]the lives and struggles of wolves, rabbits, or even wild boars[/b] with these short yet complex stories. Keep the dangers away from the animals and help them breed so their packs, colonies, and families can grow. Be careful, though, as[b] the balance in the environment is very fragile[/b].
You can lead the animals to extermination or bring balance and multiply their population. It all depends on you!

[b]Natural Instincts on Steam:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/1168610

[h1]Bundle it up![/h1]
We have an exclusive offer for everyone who can't choose between managing a farm and keeping a forest up and going -[b] a special bundle giving you a great discount on Natural Instincts and Farm Manager 2021[/b] if you buy them together in our specially created set.

Stay safe,
Natural Instincts Team & Cleversan Software

notes.title: Major Update 1.1.405
notes.content:
Dear Players, 


Below you will find the changelog: 


[h1]New Feature – Production buildings[/h1] 

We have introduced three additional production buildings to the game – bakery, smokehouse and food processing plant. The new buildings will allow you to further process some of the products currently available in Farm Manager 2021.  


[b]Bakery [/b]

Produce your own flour-based food in a new bakery building 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/a13be5dbbbd33dbb2a79c4090bcee7c21eb4c5a2.png[/img]
 

[b]Smokehouse [/b]

Instead of selling your products from the slaughterhouse, set up a smokehouse and start producing aromatic smoked meats 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/b5d734178aed57452e2b1445cad16c828fce34e1.png[/img]


[b]Food processing plant [/b]

Combine different products from your farm and produce ready meals

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/9edd6243086b537985cdf4277ed8960d79bece07.png[/img]
 

[h1]New Feature – Market demand[/h1] 
Selling one type of product causes the market to become saturated over time, and the price of the product slowly decreases. The price of the product can be reduced up to 40% of the basic price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/508c524cd2f754cb0f8f873307d6510ac16146c6.png[/img]

notes.title: Farm Manager 2021 - Patch 1.0.390
notes.content:
Dear Players,

[h1]New Feature - Irrigation System![/h1]
The irrigation system allows you to keep the fields and greenhouses always watered without having to worry about available workers. 

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Added time indicator for the estimated production of animals in the Animal Manager
- Added time indicator for the estimated production of production buildings in the Production Manager
- Added tooltips to the Animal Manager
- Added tooltips to the Staff Manager

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where the autosave would trigger while the players were browsing the menu
- Fixed a bug where the player could use the demolition tool to remove the trash piles
- Fixed a bug where the number of animals displayed in animal buildings in range in the slaughterhouse was not updating correctly
- Fixed a bug where the employee window was sometimes not displayed correctly on the screen

notes.title: Farm Manager 2021 - Patch 1.0.389
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Below you will find the changelog:

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- The "Hire and Assign" feature in buildings now works if the player has other unassigned employees
- Added new employee portraits
- Changed the perspective of the land purchase overview to make it less confusing

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where some of the building radius settings would restart after loading a saved game
- Fixed a bug where animals would not produce anything when moved from one building to another that was previously occupied by a different type of animal
- Fixed a bug where it was impossible to call a vet in Free Mode when the electricty requirement was turned off
- Fixed a bug where a tractor with a trailer for straw bales could get stuck if the field was destroyed before the tracor could deliver the bales to the warehouse

notes.title: Farm Manager 2021 - Patch 1.0.387
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Below you will find the changelog:

[h1]New features![/h1]

[b]Radius range[/b]
A new option to adjust the area of effect has been implemented for all buildings that have a radius. If you wish to change the building's default area of effect, you will need to click on the building and adjust the slider to the value that suits you.
Please note that the maximum range of the building has not been changed and this feature does not allow you to bypass it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/ebd60116f08032debd931586eaf5c461ac6ec821.png[/img]

[b]Training timer[/b]
A training timer has been added to the main UI to make it easier for you to track your training progress without having to visit the Training manager every now and then

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Scrollbars are now thicker and more visible
- The default threshold for ordering a mechanic to a new machine has been lowered to 70% durability
- Mechanic's garage will now prioritize the machine with the lowest durability
- Added straw in the Plant Picker as a subproduct of harvesting certain fields
- Road prices have been adjusted
- The checkbox has been removed from the filter area in the Hire section of Staff Manager. From now on you don't have to click it before filters become clickable
- The game optimization has been improved

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where the slaughterhouse would be built infinitely
- Fixed a bug where a field that is not an orchard could be sprayed by an orchard sprayer
- Fixed a bug where Plants skill was not working correctly
- Fixed a bug where an incorrect wage was displayed in House for seasonal employees in Free Mode on a difficulty level other than medium
- Fixed a memory leak

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
- Renovating abandoned buildings in the second abandoned farm in the campaign is now possible.

- More trees were displayed than they should be at low graphics settings

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
- Radius slider to control the area of effect of all buildings that have a radius
- Display of straw in the Plant Picker as a subproduct of harvesting fields

notes.title: Farm Manager 2021 - Patch 1.0.378

notes.title: Farm Manager 2021 - Patch 1.0.374
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Below you will find the changelog:

[h1]New feature - work type flags![/h1]
To make developing your farm easier and more enjoyable, we've added a new option that allows you to prohobit your workers from manual labour or from using machines. This solution gives you more control over your workers and thanks to it, you can avoid downtime on the fieldworks. To prohibit your employees from manual work, click on a checkbox next to "allow manual work". 
You can find the checkbox at Employee Manager in the Staff list, after clicking on a particular employee and when hiring the employee.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/5aaa4f8b7fc33f515439f464d6ae1be334edb353.png[/img]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Quitting the game is no longer possible if the save process has not yet finished. Closing the game too quickly while the save process was still in progress could corrupt the save, preventing it from loading.
- Added a slider for the employee limit for sesonal workers in House for sesonal employees

[h1]Bug fixes:[/h1]
- Fixed a bug that caused the warehouses to have the wrong capacity after loading the game
- Re-introduced the change that was reverted yesterday: Automatic field processes now use the nearest machine for field works

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
- Turning off messages generated by fields and greenhouses
- Thicker, more visible scrollbars
- Training timer visible in the main UI
- Rabbits and rabbit warrens

notes.title: Farm Manager 2021 - Patch 1.0.360
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Below you will find the changelog:


[h1]New feature - Free Mode Customization![/h1]
Looking for a challenge or a way to relax while you develop your farm? 
The new Free Mode customization options will help you choose the right difficulty level!

You can:
[list][*]disable fires, building accidents, and electricity
[*]set multipliers for monthly wages, market prices, yield size, and animal production
[*]choose one of four amounts for starting capital
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36258445/3234500ecbd5979c5d975193100469347f3f2edf.png[/img]
[h1]Changes:[/h1]
- Optimization fixes
- The range radius of the garage and parking has been significantly increased
- The range radius of the house for permanent and sesonal employees has been slightly increased
- The mechanic from mechanic's garage building is no longer called to repair newly purchased used machines, the repair level slider is set to the original quality level of the used machine.

[h1]What's next?[/h1]
We understand that the current system of AI management (Field Manager) of workers can be confusing and causes some difficulties during the game, and we have started working on the following improvements:
- Changes to the workers priority
- Option to prevent your workers from being used by AI management (Field Manager)

- Fixed a bug that caused some of the saves not loading correctly
- Fixed a bug that caused some of the sounds not being played in the Free Mode
- Saving game while baling the field will no longer cause the insufficient amount of bales created on the field
- The farm owner's house level 2 garage now works correctly

notes.title: Farm Manager 2021 - Patch 1.0.348
notes.content:
Dear Players,

Below you will find the changelog:

- Fixed a bug that caused the mechanic to get stuck, not repairing the machine and making the machine unusable with the "Waiting for the expert" status
- Fixed a bug that prevented the player from getting organic grass and organic crops from the fields
- Sesonal employees are now automatically fired after their hire date expires. This process can be delayed if the sesonal employee is currently working on a fied. In this case, the employee will be fired after completing their current work in the field
- Added possibility of producing organic silage from organic straw.
- Added organic colza honey and organic buckwheat honey
- Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the player from assigning the employee to Milk Processing Plant in the tutorial
- When clicking on a garage, the green or red marker on the field is now correctly displayed as a range indicator
- Fixed a translation issue in the German version of the game
